descripcion: Fat-soluble vitamin used in the formulation of vitamin premixes and cores for animal nutrition, and also in supplements, fortified foods and cosmetic formulations for skin care. It provides vitamin A activity associated with vision, growth and the integrity of epithelial tissues, in line with applicable regulations. It is incorporated in forms stabilized against oxidation during mixing and storage.
aplicaciones: Compound feed for poultry, swine and cattle
formas_referenciales: Solid - powder or coated microgranules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Source of vitamin D3 used in premixes and supplements for animal and human nutrition, in fortified foods, including dairy products, and in pharmaceutical and cosmetic formulations. It is associated with calcium and phosphorus metabolism and bone mineralization, in line with applicable regulations. It is handled in stabilized forms that facilitate its dosing and homogenization in compound feed.
formas_referenciales: Solid - stabilized powder or microgranules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Fat-soluble antioxidant used in premixes for animal nutrition and as a stabilizer of fats and vitamins in feed. It is associated with immune function and the protection of cell membranes against oxidation, in line with applicable regulations. It is also used in cosmetic creams, lotions and serums, and in pharmaceutical and food formulations as an antioxidant and source of vitamin E.
formas_referenciales: Viscous oily liquid or powder adsorbed on a carrier, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Source of vitamin K activity used in premixes and nucleus premixes for animal nutrition. It is associated with blood coagulation mechanisms, in accordance with applicable regulations. It is presented as a stabilized salt to improve its handling and its compatibility within the mixture.
formas_referenciales: Solid — crystalline powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Nutrient used in premixes and compound feeds as a source of choline for animal nutrition. It is associated with fat metabolism, liver function and the supply of methyl groups, in line with applicable regulations. It is offered in liquid form or supported on a carrier to facilitate its incorporation into the mix; it is also used in supplements and oral pharmaceutical preparations.
formas_referenciales: Liquid or powder on carrier, depending on the manufacturer's presentation and batch

descripcion: Osmolyte and methyl group donor compound used in formulations for animal nutrition. It is associated with intestinal osmotic balance and with sparing other methyl donors in the diet, in accordance with applicable regulations. In personal care it is used as a humectant of natural origin.
formas_referenciales: Solid — crystalline powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Source of zinc with good availability used in mineral premixes for animal nutrition. Zinc is associated with enzyme function, skin integrity, and the immune system, in accordance with applicable regulations. It is also used as a micronutrient in plant nutrition formulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Mineral oxide powder used in cosmetics as a broad-spectrum physical UV filter, opacifier and skin protection agent. It is used in sunscreens, barrier creams and dermal ointments; particle size and surface treatment are confirmed in the technical data sheet of the available batch.
formas_referenciales: Solid - powder, particle size varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Source of copper used in mineral premixes for animal nutrition. Copper is associated with iron metabolism, pigmentation and enzyme function, in line with applicable regulations. Outside animal nutrition it is used in water and pool treatment, as an agricultural trace element and as the basis of fungicidal products.
aplicaciones: Algaecide in pools and water treatment
formas_referenciales: Solid - crystals or powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Source of manganese used in mineral premixes for animal nutrition. Manganese is associated with bone formation and various enzyme systems, in line with applicable regulations. It is also used as a trace element in plant nutrition programs and as a catalytic input in chemical processes.
aplicaciones: Catalyst and reagent in chemical processes
formas_referenciales: Solid - powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Inorganic source of selenium used in premixes for animal nutrition. Selenium is associated with cellular antioxidant defense and with immune system function, in accordance with applicable regulations. Because of its high activity, it is usually handled diluted in a premix to ensure homogeneous dosing.
formas_referenciales: Solid — crystalline powder, usually in a diluted premix depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Essential amino acid used in the formulation of balanced feed for animal nutrition. It helps balance the amino acid profile of the diet and optimize the protein contribution, in accordance with applicable regulations. It is one of the most widely used limiting amino acids in diets for poultry and swine, and is also used in supplements and in cosmetic and pharmaceutical formulations, where it is associated with collagen synthesis.
aplicaciones: Supplements and cosmetic or pharmaceutical formulations
formas_referenciales: Solid - powder or granulate, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Sulfur-containing essential amino acid used in diets for animal nutrition, especially in poultry. It helps balance the amino acid profile and improve the efficiency of dietary protein, in accordance with applicable regulations. It is usually the first limiting amino acid in poultry formulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — crystalline powder or flakes, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Essential amino acid used in the formulation of balanced feed for animal nutrition. It helps balance the amino acid profile and formulate diets with lower crude protein, in accordance with applicable regulations. It is used mainly in swine and poultry diets.
formas_referenciales: Solid — crystalline powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Essential amino acid used in animal nutrition diets to complete the amino acid profile. It is associated with feed intake and dietary balance, in accordance with applicable regulations. It is also used as an ingredient in nutraceutical supplements.
formas_referenciales: Solid — crystalline powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Short-chain acidifier used in formulations for animal nutrition and in the preservation of grains and forages. It is associated with the control of pH and microbial load in feed, in accordance with applicable regulations. Beyond animal nutrition it is used in various industrial and agricultural processes.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — solution with a concentration that varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Acidifier and preservative agent used in balanced feed and in the preservation of moist grains. It is associated with the inhibition of mold growth and the control of pH, in accordance with applicable regulations. It is also used as a preservative in the food industry.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — solution with a concentration that varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Salt of butyric acid used in formulations for animal nutrition as a source of short-chain fatty acids. It is associated with supporting the integrity of the intestinal mucosa and with digestive health, in accordance with applicable regulations. It is offered in coated or uncoated presentations depending on the desired release point.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or microgranules, coated or uncoated depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Enzyme used in balanced feed to release the phosphorus bound to phytate in plant ingredients. Its use is associated with better utilization of phosphorus and other minerals and with lower excretion, in accordance with applicable regulations. It is handled in liquid or coated granulated presentations to withstand the pelleting process.
formas_referenciales: Liquid or coated granules, depending on the manufacturer's presentation and batch

descripcion: Enzyme that acts on the arabinoxylans of cereals, used in balanced feed for animal nutrition. Its use is associated with an improvement in the digestibility and energy value of the diet, in accordance with applicable regulations. It is also used in food industry processes.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules, or a liquid presentation depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Enzyme that promotes the breakdown of dietary proteins, used in balanced feed for animal nutrition. Its use is associated with better utilization of amino acids and with greater consistency in digestibility, in accordance with applicable regulations. Enzymes of this type are also used in industrial and institutional detergency.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules, or a liquid presentation depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Yeast used in formulations for animal nutrition as a functional additive and source of metabolites. It is associated with the balance of the microbiota and with the stability of rumen fermentation, in accordance with applicable regulations. It also provides nucleotides and cell wall components of nutritional interest.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Probiotic microorganism (microbial additive) used in formulations for animal nutrition. It is associated with the balance of the intestinal microbiota and with digestive stability, in accordance with applicable regulations. It is handled in the form of spores on a carrier to improve its stability during processing.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder on a carrier, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Adsorbent of mineral origin used in formulations for animal nutrition in order to capture mycotoxins present in raw materials. Its use is associated with reducing the availability of certain mycotoxins in the digestive tract, in accordance with applicable regulations. It also acts as an anticaking and flow agent in the mixture.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder, particle size varies depending on the manufacturer and batch
